authority.scope: Compare installed GTK2 and a one-property GTK2 candidate to the exact SR10.4 horizontal scrollbar cells at 1:1; do not install changes.

reference.system: Domain/OS SR10.4, HP VUE 2.01, Trash Can horizontal scrollbar

method.runtime: GTK 2.24.33; actual GtkHScrollbar in the project's owned Xephyr :187.
method.installed: Current installed GTK2 wrapper and generated palette include.
method.candidate: Temporary copy of the installed wrapper and generated palette; only GtkRange::trough-under-steppers = 0 was added inside the existing palette style. Theme assets and KDE-derived role data were copied unchanged.

source_files.candidate_palette_diff: The copied generated palette adds exactly one GtkRange property declaration; its GTK engine and assets are preserved.

results.interpretation: The property changes the actual cell drawing and shifts the best local match, but the candidate is less similar to the SR10.4 reference for both directions even when locally re-registered. This rejects this property as the fix; it does not prove why the installed render differs from the reference or establish overall GTK2 fidelity.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Completes an exact 1:1 comparison of installed and one-property candidate horizontal arrow cells to the exact SR10.4 source. Renderer cause, pressed historical pairings, other GTK2 states, and user review remain pending.

next: Keep GTK2 active. Inspect the effective GTK2 pixmap stepper and overlay drawing geometry to locate the remaining render mismatch; test one source-supported variable at a time and leave the product unchanged until the exact VUE comparison improves.
